name: Tomosaka Shuri
source:
“Anju, when are you going to fall in love? You should experience lots of love while you’re still young.”

The same age as Anju, and a companion at both the same university and the same part-time job. She appears listless and unmotivated, but in truth she’s simply conserving her energy so she can pour everything into her art. Warm-hearted and considerate, with a gentle nature that shows in her quiet thoughtfulness.

View on romance:

Enjoys love freely, without restraint.

[Translated from the [url=https://lamina-pla.net/Keylabox/chara.html]official website[/url]]
